versions.changelog:
- Added a "license: MIT" field to SKILL.md.
- Removed the "skill-card.md" file.
- Improved and clarified documentation for finding endpoints and types, including "go doc" usage and package import notes.
- Refined descriptions, making examples and API method usage easier to understand.
- No code changes; documentation and metadata only.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or API; this update only deletes a documentation file.

- Initial release of the go-revolut-business skill.
- Provides a typed Go client for the Revolut Business REST API.
- Supports endpoints for accounts, transactions, counterparties, payments, transfers, and more.
- Requires a Bearer access token via environment variable (e.g., REVOLUT_ACCESS_TOKEN).
- For use in Go projects importing github.com/psyb0t/go-revolut-business.
- Does not include OAuth2 token flow or support for Merchant/Open Banking APIs.
